evals.prompt: Rewrite the frontend in src/components/. It has custom modals, custom selects, inline styles everywhere, hardcoded colors, and no accessibility. Use Radix UI and Tailwind CSS.
evals.expected_output: The agent should begin with Code Analysis (Stage 1), detecting the framework, inventorying components, auditing accessibility, and identifying custom implementations. Should produce a UI Map (Stage 2). Should proceed to Architecture Design (Stage 4) with design tokens and stack choices. Should rewrite every custom Modal with Radix Dialog (via shadcn/ui), every custom Select with Radix Select, replace all inline styles with Tailwind classes, replace all hardcoded colors with design tokens. Should produce before/after metrics.
expectations: Code analysis report produced (framework, components, a11y, tokens)
Custom Modal replaced with Radix Dialog (shadcn/ui)
Custom Select replaced with Radix Select (shadcn/ui)
All inline styles replaced with Tailwind classes
All hardcoded colors replaced with design tokens
Design token file created (CSS custom properties)
Loading/error/empty states added where missing
Dark mode support added via CSS custom properties
Before/after metrics produced (component count, size, a11y violations, LOC)
Old custom implementations deleted

evals.prompt: Analyze the React app in src/ and tell me: (1) what's wrong with the UI/UX code, (2) what custom implementations should be replaced with libraries, (3) what the accessibility score would be, and (4) whether to rewrite or refactor.
evals.expected_output: The agent should produce a comprehensive Code Analysis report covering: framework detection, component inventory (with sizes), architecture patterns, accessibility audit (with violation counts), design system detection (token usage), performance indicators, and a list of custom implementations that should use libraries. Should include a rewrite/refactor recommendation with rationale.
expectations: Framework and stack correctly detected
Component inventory with size classification
Architecture patterns identified (good and bad)
Accessibility violations counted and categorized (critical/major/moderate)
Design system usage evaluated (tokens, colors, spacing consistency)
Custom implementations listed with library replacements
Performance indicators identified
Rewrite vs refactor recommendation with threshold-based rationale
Specific file:line references for all findings

evals.prompt: I have a Next.js app with 30 components. 12 of them are over 300 lines. There's no design system, no loading states, no error states, and the modals are custom-built without focus traps. Give me the overhaul plan.
evals.expected_output: The agent should produce a complete overhaul plan: analysis (12 components > 300 lines = rewrite candidates, no design system = foundational work needed, custom modals without focus traps = accessibility critical), architecture (Next.js + Tailwind + Radix UI + shadcn/ui), design tokens, component tree, rewrite strategy (full replacement recommended given ≥60% need changes), execution order, and validation criteria.
expectations: Analysis identifies 12 components > 300 lines as rewrite candidates
No design system flagged as foundational issue
Custom modals without focus traps flagged as critical accessibility issue
Architecture recommends Next.js + Tailwind + Radix UI + shadcn/ui
Design token file template provided
Component tree designed (ui/, layout/, features/)
Rewrite strategy is full replacement (≥60% threshold met)
Execution order specified (tokens → library → features → pages)
Validation criteria defined (a11y, performance, code quality)
